decision: Use the official T2 taxi rank. Do not count on the Airport Link.
steps: Before boarding, tell Grand Hyatt you may reach the hotel after midnight. Ask the property to confirm it will hold the room; the hotel listing cannot prove this.
After baggage claim, follow the airport's taxi signs to the official T2 taxi area outside Arrivals Gate 25. Use the address panel below instead of needing a data connection.
Before accepting a ride, confirm how you can pay. Keep enough RMB cash for the ride if you already have it; do not assume foreign cards or QR payment will work.
backup: If you cannot arrange a taxi, ask airport staff before leaving arrivals. The published late-night bus lists Century Avenue Metro Station. It is not a hotel drop-off: verify boarding, payment and how you will reach the hotel from the stop before using it.
boundary: Transport can change. This rehearsal uses reported terminal and time from a fictional input; it does not verify a real flight, booking, fare or late check-in.

decision: Take Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui if it is operating.
steps: Follow the signs to the Pudong Airport Metro station, confirm Line 2 service to Lujiazui and ask a staffed counter which non-QR options it accepts before entering.
Use the Park Hyatt / Shanghai World Financial Center address, not Grand Hyatt / Jin Mao Tower. The properties have different entrances and street numbers.
If you cannot buy a ticket or service is disrupted, take the staffed official taxi route rather than relying on an app you cannot pay with.
backup: The official T1 taxi rank is outside Arrivals Gate 12; the airport also lists access from Arrivals Gates 4 or 8. Confirm the driver's payment method before departure and show the bilingual address below.
